title: EvaluationCase v1
description: A frozen evaluation case (ARCHITECTURE 3.8; ADR-0006 decision 1): frozen input hash, claim type, domain label, split, resource budget, the scoring contract binding, and contamination status. The case is the immutable question; what a candidate answered and how it scored live in evaluation-run/v1.

domain.description: Domain label only (for example math, quant, ml, dl). Carries no domain semantics inside the core.

claim_type.description: Governance claim type a successful answer on this case would support (mirrors research-claim/v1 claim_type).

split.description: Evaluation split (ADR-0006 decision 11). Contaminated cases must not feed conclusion text outside development.

content_sha256.description: Hash of the frozen case input artifact. The hash is authoritative.

locator.description: Optional safe relative path to the frozen input artifact.

notes.description: Optional free-text note about the frozen input.

input.description: The frozen case input, bound by content hash.

scorer_level.description: Scorer level (ADR-0006 decision 5). calibrated_judge without calibration evidence is a label only and never outranks a structured rubric.

contract_sha256.description: Hash of the full scoring-contract artifact (rubric text, checker config, oracle definition).

notes.description: Optional free-text note about the scoring contract.

evaluation_contract.description: The scoring contract this case is judged under, bound by content hash.

resources.description: Resource budget the case demands (time, memory, output size). Free-form in v1; the binding enforcement lives in the run envelope.

contamination_status.description: Contamination state of this case (ADR-0006 decision 11). The ledger records detail; the case carries the state.
